cohort: 87 women with twin pregnancies > 34 weeks gestation undergoing induction of labor
finding: Induction of labor with Dinoprostone Gel, Misoprostol Vaginal Insert, and Dinoprostone Vaginal Insert appears to be equally safe and effective in twin pregnancies.
mod_finding: This study compared different methods of labor induction in twin pregnancies and found no significant differences in mode of delivery between the groups.
